title: Preserve healthchecks in OCI image configs
body:
Required by https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/pull/7220

Preserve Docker healthchecks when converting Docker schema 2 images to OCI, and expose them when inspecting OCI images.

Serialization is byte-for-byte identical when no healthcheck is present -- existing OCI image digests remain stable.

---

There's also a small behavioral correction I've made; `config.Healthcheck` now takes precedence over `container_config.Healthcheck`. Docker documents `ContainerConfig` as a legacy implementation detail of the classic image builder; it is not portable, is deprecated, and has been removed from newer Docker Engine APIs. See the depreciation note [here](https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/master/docs/deprecated.md#container-and-containerconfig-fields-in-image-inspect). Consequently, `container_config.Healthcheck` will only be used as a fallback when `config` is entirely absent. Previously, we could incorrectly pick up stale builder metadata instead of the actual image configuration.
I have no problem extracting it to a separate PR if you think it warrants independent review.

---
